baseline_bootstrap.protocol: Serial; compiler then portable CLI, reversed in alternate rounds. Cold removes only this isolated checkout's merge-tool image/stamp and starts a fresh guest cache; warm reuses both. Outputs are always regenerated. Node processes/JIT are fresh; OS page cache is warm. Packaging, installation and native runner compilation are excluded. Host spans and end-of-run memory counters are enabled; no CPU profiling.
baseline_bootstrap.memory: Simultaneous process-tree RSS sampled every20ms; shared pages can be double-counted. Per-process first/last observations are bounds, not exact lifetimes. Guest bump frontier/allocation/committed memory are retained in logs, not inferred from RSS.

baseline_matrix.protocol: Native JIT primed on a different input; fresh guest cache per round/variant, cold followed by warm in new processes. Forward/reverse/forward order; equal-length lane and cache paths. o0/a0 are A/A controls; s0 is the same-driver serial reference; p1/p2/p4 are whole public native frontend builds. Target RC1; parent/worker engines bump, coordinator RC. Checked-module/body/final-artifact caches off. RSS sampled every20ms; shared mappings may be double-counted. No concurrent builds/profiles.

candidate_build.negative_control: Only adapter replaced by portable byte-wise reference; same ownership/truncation tests compile/run, long-name allocation oracle fails.

authority.protocol: Fixed archived baseline corpus and generated inputs for both lanes. a0/aa corrected-digest main, b0 owned bulk product strings; context6/job2/ABI2 unchanged. Per-round fresh guest cache, cold then warm in new processes. Native JIT primed separately. Equal-length lane/cache/output paths. Forward/reverse/forward AB order; no concurrent heavy jobs. Whole public process-worker frontend, supported targetRC1, parent/worker bump and coordinatorRC. Ordinary, same-driver serial and1/2/4 workers all measured. Simultaneous /proc RSS sampled20ms; shared mappings may be double-counted. This is not threaded bootstrap/default promotion.

wasm_instrumentation.method: Replace only the validated i64.const0 marker body with a read of the exported mutable i32 heap global. All other section payloads and function bodies remain unchanged.
wasm_instrumentation.calibration: Main grants Profiler::heap_bytes and requires exact equality with the inserted observer before printing. Native final raw heap_peak is independently checked.

parent_phase_before.scope: Diagnostic entry-copy only. Precise bump-frontier boundaries, not walltime wins. Parent spans worker-group/execute-total contain child spans; never sum inclusive ancestors.
